title.zh: 【BitMine 6 小时前质押存入 15.97 万枚 ETH，价值约 3.9 亿美元】
title.en: 【BitMine 6 小时前质押存入 15.97 万枚 ETH，价值约 3.9 亿美元】

current_state.zh: BitMine staked 159,728 ETH (about $390M) six hours prior, bringing its reported total staked ETH above 5.227M (~$12.8B), while Ethereum's entry queue holds 1.33M ETH with a 23+ day wait versus only ~149K ETH queued to exit.
